title: A 3-Foot Snake Swallows Eggs Far Wider Than Its Head
subject: egg-eating snake

scenes.text: A three-foot snake swallows eggs far wider than its head.
The Gans' egg-eater has stretchy skin between its lower jawbones, which lets its mouth open far wider than a normal snake's.
It swallows the egg whole, then bends its spine to crack the shell inside its body.
Then it brings the empty broken shell back up and leaves it behind.
A 2023 study found it can swallow prey three to four times bigger than a black rat snake can.
Relative to its size, it beats even a Burmese python.

description:
